envelope.description: Full-surface visual verification in both themes, with committed evidence

body.title: Full-surface visual verification in both themes, with committed evidence
body.summary: The whole-surface pass, CONFIRMING rather than discovering now that t3 read the renderer in isolation. Render the real shell across every state — each of the four real records, the dual-slot arrangement, unshowable, absent, and a deep card at narrow pane width — screenshot headless in BOTH themes, READ the images back, and commit them under S004/evidence/ with the evidence-path guard extended to name each one.
acceptanceChecks: Each of the four real records in the MOUNTED surface reads as an interface, confirmed by reading the image
The DUAL-SLOT layout read as an image: diagram and mock as labelled peers, each distinguishable at a glance — the only way to confirm a reviewer could actually tell them apart (ac2)

BOTH THEMES (critique): dark and light, for at least the dual-slot, one real record and the unshowable state. The light theme is where a wrong `--it-*` choice becomes visible and where a mechanical colour scan has nothing to say
The 'unshowable' state: the reason text is legible and the link-out visibly reachable
The 'absent' state: nothing drawn, no frame, no reserved space, and the body identical to the S003 rendering
A deep card at narrow pane width renders legibly, confirming t4's bound did not need to fire

All state images committed under S004/evidence/ at the paths the commit message CLAIMS, with the evidence-path guard extended — S002 committed evidence to the wrong path while its message claimed the right one and had to be amended
